description.value: The Pemberton Hotel is a historic local institution dating to around 1914, operating as an affordable hotel and community hub in the heart of Pemberton on the Sea-to-Sky corridor. The property includes an on-site pub, liquor store, and cannabis store, making it a practical stop for touring cyclists stocking up between Whistler and the rest of the region. It sits steps from restaurants, a supermarket, and a gas station, with free parking on site.
